reason: Conversation 1 correctly diagnosed the dryer heater/thermal cut-out circuit from the first reply, obtained the full model number before any part talk, consistently insisted on unplugging and refitting the lid, flagged lint blockage as a root cause, explained the reset-vs-one-shot distinction without ever suggesting a bypass, and offered a sensible meter-or-engineer escalation.
